ADDITIONAL PROTOCOL ON THE PROTECTION OF PERSONAL DATA
The present Additional Protocol has been executed by NETAŞ TELEKOMÜNİKASYON A.Ş. and …….………………. in addition to the contract/contracts signed between NETAŞ TELEKOMÜNİKASYON A.Ş. (hereinafter referred to as "NETAŞ") and ........................ (hereinafter referred to as the "COMPANY"). NETAŞ and the COMPANY will be hereinafter referred to as the "Parties" collectively and as a "Party" individually.
Article 1. Subject of the Protocol
The subject of this protocol is the regulation of the obligations of the COMPANY regarding personal data in accordance with the The Personal Data Protection Law no. 6698 (“KVKK”), all applicable laws, secondary regulations and resolutions of the Data Protection Authorities.
Article 2. Provisions for the KVKK and All Applicable Laws:
1.	The Company is obliged to use any data that is to be shared with it and which is defined as Personal Data and Sensitive Personal Data (to be referred to as Personal Data collectively) under KVKK and other applicable laws, only and exclusively for performance of its …………… contract with NETAŞ. The Company may not transfer this data to any third parties or entities in any way, except where permitted by the contract and with the conditions of transfer or may not use it for any other purpose in any other contractual relationship or in any other activity, whether commercial or not. The COMPANY is personally responsible for securing the confidentiality of this information. The Company may not use, process, distribute, transfer to the third persons or entities or transfer to abroad and otherwise process any Personal Data obtained by it as a result of the activities and all documents, tools and materials and all other items related to such data beyond their purpose, in any other contractual relationship or any other business.
2.	The COMPANY is obliged to take all precautions, regulated in the KVKK and other applicable laws for protection of Personal Data, obtained by it from NETAŞ, ensure its privacy, act in accordance with the privacy principles, take all precautions to prevent use of such data by unauthorized persons and protect against all types of abuse and meet all administrative and technical precautions in the resolution adopted by the Data Protection Authorities and train its employees, advisors, representatives and those processing personal data and sensitive personal data on behalf of it in respect of the KVKK, all applicable laws and its applications, prepare the required policies and procedures and put them into application. This obligation of the COMPANY shall continue indefinitely even in the case of termination of this protocol.
3.	The Company is obliged to take all kinds of technical and administrative precautions to prevent the unlawful processing of the Personal Data, except for the exceptions listed in the KVKK and other applicable laws, prevent the unlawful access to the Personal Data, in order to provide the level of security in the standards which may be introduced under any resolutions to be adopted by the Data Protection Authorities or regulations to be enacted pursuant to the KVKK and other legal regulations for protection of the Personal Data. Any legal, administrative and criminal liability that may arise in case of violation of this provision shall belong to the COMPANY and compensation for any damages arising from the breach of these provisions shall also belong to the COMPANY. In the event of such a breach, NETAŞ shall have the right to immediately terminate the contract and this Additional Protocol without compensation. In addition, NETAŞ and/or injured persons reserve their right to file a criminal complaint to the Prosecution Office against the responsible persons or apply to the Data Protection Authorities.
4.	If, as a result of a violation of these provisions by the COMPANY, NETAŞ has to pay an administrative fine or compensation to 3rd parties, this administrative fine and / or compensation amount and their accessories will be charged to the COMPANY by NETAŞ.
5.	In order to ensure the implementation of the provisions of KVKK and other applicable laws, the COMPANY has to carry out or have others carry out the necessary audits under the KVKK and other applicable laws in its own headquarter or subsidiaries or subcontractors engaged by written approval of If, as a result of a violation of these provisions by the COMPANY, NETAŞ has to pay an administrative fine or compensation to 3rd parties, this administrative fine and / or compensation amount and their accessories will be charged to the COMPANY by NETAŞ.  By signing this protocol, the COMPANY agrees and undertakes that the persons, appointed by If, as a result of a violation of these provisions by the COMPANY, NETAŞ has to pay an administrative fine or compensation to 3rd parties, this administrative fine and / or compensation amount and their accessories will be charged to the COMPANY by NETAŞ for audit, are authorized to request from it for all kinds of information and documents related to the actions undertaken by the COMPANY, that its data processing systems and books will be available to the audit by If, as a result of a violation of these provisions by the COMPANY, NETAŞ has to pay an administrative fine or compensation to 3rd parties, this administrative fine and / or compensation amount and their accessories will be charged to the COMPANY by NETAŞ for conduct of such audits.
6.	The COMPANY agrees, declares and undertakes to notify If, as a result of a violation of these provisions by the COMPANY, NETAŞ has to pay an administrative fine or compensation to 3rd parties, this administrative fine and / or compensation amount and their accessories will be charged to the COMPANY by NETAŞ immediately in a secure manner if the processed Personal Data is obtained by others by unlawful means.
7.	The COMPANY shall provide all kinds of information and documents to be requested by the Data Protection Authorities in a timely and accurate manner, and record and access to all electronic, magnetic and similar media related to them. and all systems and passwords necessary to make the records readable and ready to operate.
8.	The COMPANY is liable to take all kinds of security measures in order to protect and prevent disclosure of any personal data delivered to it by If, as a result of a violation of these provisions by the COMPANY, NETAŞ has to pay an administrative fine or compensation to 3rd parties, this administrative fine and / or compensation amount and their accessories will be charged to the COMPANY by NETAŞ, without prejudice to the exceptions in the KVKK and other applicable laws, inform and train its personnel and make and maintain the legal arrangements required fulfill the obligations under the KVKK and other applicable laws.
9.	In the event that the subcontractor is used in the performance of the services that are subject to the contract with the written approval of If, as a result of a violation of these provisions by the COMPANY, NETAŞ has to pay an administrative fine or compensation to 3rd parties, this administrative fine and / or compensation amount and their accessories will be charged to the COMPANY by NETAŞ, the COMPANY agrees and undertakes that the foregoing provisions will be fully included in the contracts and protocols to be concluded with the subcontractors and that it will be liable to If, as a result of a violation of these provisions by the COMPANY, NETAŞ has to pay an administrative fine or compensation to 3rd parties, this administrative fine and / or compensation amount and their accessories will be charged to the COMPANY by NETAŞ for compensation of all losses, which may arise from violation of these provisions by these firms severally and jointly with these firms.
In accordance with the above provisions, this Protocol has been signed on .... / .... / 2021 in addition to the contract dated ..../..../20......
NETAŞ TELEKOMÜNİKASYON A.Ş.
